blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Mission total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Lake Errock home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 houses sold in Lake Errock with a median price of $865,000 (the middle half sold between $710,000 and $977,500), taking a median of 102 days to sell at 95.3% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $359 per square foot, a median year built of 2007 and a median lot of 7,800 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Lake Errock?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 16 houses listed in Lake Errock. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Lake Errock a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Lake Errock had a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Lake Errock from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 4 houses sold in Lake Errock over those 4 months, out of 124 in all of Mission.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Lake Errock?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Lake Errock sell for?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Lake Errock between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $865,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Lake Errock?
faq.a: The median was 102 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.3% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
